summary: Patient missed the appointment because she never received a reminder message and forgot.
recommended_action: Reschedule the appointment and verify reminder contact preferences.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to distance and a lack of available transport that morning.
recommended_action: Offer telehealth options or assist with transport coordination for future visits.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to high consultation fees and inquired about discounts.
recommended_action: Provide information regarding available financial assistance, payment plans, or follow-up discounts.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to high fever and body ache, and will reschedule after recovery.
recommended_action: Contact the patient after a few days to reschedule the visit once they recover.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to an urgent office meeting and requested an evening slot next time.
recommended_action: Reschedule the appointment for an evening time slot.

summary: Patient forgot the appointment because no SMS reminder was received and wishes to rebook.
recommended_action: Enable SMS reminders and assist the patient with rescheduling.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to a city bus strike and lack of available transport from their location.
recommended_action: Offer telehealth options or assistance with transportation planning for future visits.

summary: Patient unreachable as phone was switched off during multiple call attempts.
recommended_action: Send an automated text reminder and a follow-up letter to reschedule.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to a factory shift change and inability to secure leave.
